params.1078: Reading this scroll permanently unlocks the wasteless smithing ability: when smithing an item that requires three bars or more, there is a chance that you will retain one bar. The chance is 50% for bronze items, 25% for iron, 20% for steel, 10% for mithril, 8% for adamant and 5% for rune.
params.1077: You need a Smithing level of 55 to access this item.
